responsibility: This header defines the `emag_tunings` model for AppliedMicro eMAG in the AArch64 backend. It mostly reuses the X-Gene 1 family’s extra-costs, address costs, register-move costs, vector costs, approximation modes, and prefetch settings, but packages them as the named tuning profile for eMAG so backend heuristics can select the appropriate cost and scheduling assumptions for that processor family.
